records.subject: Pt-free thermocells
records.object: Output power density of 12 W m−2
records.quote: Pt-free thermocells devised here provide an output power of 12 W m(-2) for an interelectrode temperature difference (Delta T) of 81 degrees C, which is sixfold higher power than previously reported for planar thermocells operating at ambient pressure.
records.conditions: Interelectrode temperature difference of 81 °C; sixfold higher power than previously reported planar thermocells operating at ambient pressure
